declared_in_advance: Round 3's read is a single number: its pooled-gate yield, compared against the frozen 0.8067 and 0.805. No family-level or per-block reading substitutes for it.

Adding round 3 to C0_ROUNDS re-pools the whole population, so rounds 1, 1b and 2's own pooled-gate yields may move again. The pre-round-3 values are recorded here and the post-round-3 values will be reported beside them; the baseline is not silently restated.
A mid-run pass rate off the capture log is not the read. The cohort is ordered by family, so any prefix of it is a block of one or two families, not a sample.

The control budget was pre-registered at 4 per family across the 17 drawing families = 68. A realized count below 68 is reported short and never topped up. Twelve of the 17 families contribute 1 to 3 rows, so at most 37 controls can be drawn; a shortfall against 68 is expected and is not a failure.
Round 3 exhausts the cohort and so terminates the sequence. If its pooled yield drops materially against the frozen baseline, the result is stop-and-report, not a further round.
The census is re-run over the re-pooled corpus rather than left describing a corpus master no longer holds.
Scope fence: no rubric weight changes, no registry row edits, no API output changes, nothing outside the C0 cohort.

measured_since_the_baseline_froze_as_of_.note: Recorded so the pre-round-3 state of every declared round is on the record before round 3 re-pools it. The stop rule still compares against the frozen pair above.

read_from.why: A round's own-gate yield is what produced the 43.5% false stop on BEAAA-33677, and round 2 read 21.5% own-gate against 84.5% pooled. The stop rule is a statement about the C0 population, so it is read over the population.

stop_rule_baseline_frozen_as_history.rule: These two literals are the comparison. They are NOT restated to whatever a later re-pooling produces, and BEAAA-33712's card names them explicitly.
